# chapter 5: what a run of full +IPD leaves waits for more, once; a chat after a screenful is not held
mask .*\\x[0-9A-F][0-9A-F].* <romlog>
mask x{100,} <xs>
wait WIFI GOT IP\r\n 5000
send ATE0
wait \r\nOK\r\n
server hold
send AT+CIPSTART="TCP","127.0.0.1",<port>
wait \r\nOK\r\n
# a screenful: one full +IPD at once, the 540 left wait 250 ms for more
peer 
pause 100
peer A1
pause 100
peer A2
# ...and go with what came meanwhile; from here on each line by itself
pause 200
print -- after the wait
peer B1
pause 100
print -- B1 by now
peer B2
pause 100
print -- B2 by now
peer B3
quiet 300
send AT+CIPCLOSE
wait \r\nOK\r\n
